deadline.value: Apply by 1 January for maximum consideration for Fall; the college says deadlines are otherwise flexible.
deadline.quote: apply by January 1 for maximum consideration for Fall and Summer admission

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, and any score submitted is reviewed holistically.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for any Department in the College of Science & Engineering

also.quote: Any submitted GRE score is part of a holistic review of each application

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

fee_waiver.value: The $60 fee can be waived on request for some qualified applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: The $60 application fee could be waived upon request for some qualified applicants

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT of 80 (or 550 paper-based), with a telephone interview possible for a waiver.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL score of 80 (internet based) or 550 (paper based) is required

also.quote: applicant may request a telephone interview with the department for possible waiver of the TOEFL

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: or a minimum IELTS score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: A TOEFL or IELTS score is required for international students; the department may waive the TOEFL after a telephone interview.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS is required for all international students

supervisor.value: The page does not state a rule on when a supervisor must agree.

funding.value: Every admitted student gets a stipend and tuition/fee waiver, including international students.
funding.quote: All admitted students are guaranteed a stipend and tuition/fee waiver. This includes international students.

also.quote: The current regular stipend for teaching and research assistants in the Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry is $28,600 per year

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: Catalog code CHEM-PHD. Department stipend figure is the 2026-27 stipend quoted on the page.
